qualification: source-only; not built, tested, linted, formatted or runtime-qualified

implemented.scope: Validated BSS conversion and synchronous bounded collection of up to 64 service scan rows, including WPA/RSN security parsing and WPS presence. No heap allocation, stock pointers or proprietary CPU calls.
implemented.shared_security_api: parse_security_elements(&[u8]) returns typed SecurityElements { wpa, rsn, wpa_group, rsn_group, wps } or ScanError::TruncatedElements. GroupCipher distinguishes Unspecified, Wep40, Wep104, Tkip and Ccmp independently from the pairwise cipher. SecurityElements::legacy_privacy(Capabilities) retains WPA/RSN presence gating even when a security body is malformed. The API exposes ScanRow's observation/parser engine without requiring dummy BSS metadata. New public-parser and mixed-group/pairwise behavioral tests remain unrun.
group_cipher_bytes: 0x013329fc..0x01332a04 initializes the RSN group selector at output+8 to16. 0x01332b2c..0x01332b3c replaces it with the decoded explicit group selector when four bytes remain.
0x013332dc..0x013332e4 initializes the WPA group selector at output+8 to8.
0x013326f0..0x013328dc maps RSN OUI selectors1,2,4,5 to masks2,8,16,4 respectively; unknown suites return0. The group cipher is not inferred from pairwise selection.
raw_observations: 0x013d7ff0-0x013d7ff8 compares count > limit, not count >= limit. The owned collector consequently admits up to 64 rows. Empty-input count preservation belongs to the actor compatibility edge.
0x013d8020-0x013d80a8 establishes flags, address, SSID, SSID length, frequency and signed signal output offsets.
0x013d8100-0x013d822c gives personal precedence over enterprise and CCMP precedence over TKIP.
0x013d825c-0x013d82d4 establishes privacy gating and infrastructure precedence over independent mode.
0x01330ca0 dispatches to 0x013329bc for RSN and 0x0133329c for WPA.
0x013329bc-0x01332f74 confirms RSN defaults, count validation, PMKID underflow rejection and ignored trailing bytes. No management cipher branch is emitted.
intentional_boundary_changes: SSID length above 32 and truncated element lists return typed errors before conversion.

peer_roster.behavior: Ten-address roster, duplicate suppression, insertion/removal, peer count, 12-byte notifications kind 0x6705/0x6706 to destination 0x57.
peer_roster.intentional_changes: Full roster and unknown disconnect return typed errors instead of count divergence or out-of-bounds writes.

channel_lease_lookup.behavior: Primary then secondary table lookup, bound-state admission and provisional primary lease admission requiring both channel and entry flags.
channel_lease_lookup.abi_correction: The exact C declaration calls 0x012fe7b8 copy_network_node_pair and returns void. Actual instructions return the lease pointer. No stock structure is reproduced in the Rust implementation.

dhcp.behavior: Validated BOOTP/DHCP options, overloaded fields, Discover/Request/Decline/Release/Inform lease ownership, five-second offer expiration, finite/infinite lease expiration, reply payload construction and destination selection.
dhcp.reply_layout: 548-byte body with observed option padding and server/mask/router/DNS fields; infinite configured lease advertises 10000 seconds.
dhcp.intentional_changes: Typed truncation and length errors replace unchecked reads. Client identifier echo includes all identifier bytes rather than the stock two-byte-short copy.
dhcp.qualification_limit: The new owned DHCP state machine is not an instruction-equivalence claim for the NONMATCHING 0x0131be84 draft. Raw admission and reply construction were inspected; full state-path qualification remains open.

ipv4_udp.behavior: Allocation-free IPv4 UDP parsing and encoding, header validation, UDP pseudo-header checksum, odd-length and cross-chunk checksum handling.
ipv4_udp.qualification_limit: The preserved UDP parser rejects fragmented input. The composed LAN runtime consumes the owned transport reassembler before this parser; see vendor_wireless_network_lan.evidence.json and transport evidence.

open_cpu_frontier.operation: Queue kind 12 and store scan completion notification; CPU consumer is not implemented here.
Network selection CPU mailbox and association path, not a physical radio boundary.
Kind 16 is CancelWps. The pinned source/byte trace follows the table at 0x013d8d98..0x013d8e20 to 0x013e0b18 and wpas_wps_cancel. Service ApplyConfiguration selector != 0 cancels WPS.
WPS configuration, queue kind 15, hostap processing and generated PIN path.
LAN CPU composition now uses owned LanRuntime. Radio initialization/AP control remain in the radio/station partition; see vendor_wireless_network_lan.evidence.json.
Owned LAN has explicit station/AP/static mode admission. Parent composes concrete radio/station setup before LAN start.
Raw instructions establish readiness wait, lease lookup and address propagation. 0x013e882c is not DHCP start. Owned LAN publishes address, route and lease synchronously.
Owned LAN stop clears server/client, transport, reassembly, sockets, pending output and address state before publishing Down. Parent subsequently tears down radio/service.
Configuration bank reads and physical radio parameter installation belong to radio lifecycle, not the network packet CPU.
Owned server stop clears lease state; LanRuntime stop composes full owned network teardown. Parent owns physical format/radio teardown.
Peer roster CPU behavior implemented; notification enqueue and full integration remain open.
